analysis.title: SXXP Earnings — Week Ahead 26–30 October 2026
key_insights: 109 SXXP companies, about 30% of index market cap, report in the week of 26–30 October 2026, a significant step-up in the earnings calendar.

Energy has the greatest European exposure: ten reporters cover about 77% of sector market cap. Shell and TotalEnergies on Thursday account for the majority of the roughly 54% of sector cap reporting that day. ExxonMobil on Friday extends the sector read-through into the weekend.
Financials lead by number of reporters, with 32 names covering about 39% of sector market cap.
Healthcare exposure is about 37% of sector market cap, led by Novartis on Tuesday and AstraZeneca on Friday.
The calendar builds through midweek, with 31 names on Wednesday and a peak of 40 on Thursday.

The US earnings calendar also peaks on Thursday, with Communication Services carrying the greatest earnings exposure. Google and Microsoft report Wednesday and Amazon on Thursday, making midweek the key window for Technology and AI sentiment.
Oracle's Analyst Day on Friday is an additional event to watch.
earnings_insights: Week of 26–30 Oct 2026: 109 SXXP companies (about 30% of index market cap) are scheduled to report. These are scheduled reports, not results.
Energy: ten reporters, about 77% of sector market cap. Shell and TotalEnergies report Thursday. ExxonMobil reports Friday.
Financials: 32 reporters, about 39% of sector market cap. Nine report Wednesday and ten report Friday.
Healthcare: about 37% of sector market cap reports. Novartis reports Tuesday and AstraZeneca reports Friday.
US names scheduled: Google and Microsoft on Wednesday, Amazon on Thursday, ExxonMobil on Friday. Oracle holds its Analyst Day on Friday.
Daily counts of SXXP reporters: Monday 2, Tuesday 16, Wednesday 31, Thursday 40, Friday 20.
vol_and_positioning: The note points to UBS research on options-implied earnings moves for the key names but gives no figures in this document.
